a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 50s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, long wavy platinum silver hair — full body near-black wenge wood carved directly over her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING near-black wenge grain across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID gold-tan pinstripes running between the carved sections, with carved relief of vines and leaves across the surface of every section, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: classical contrapposto stance, weight on one leg, one hand holding the other forearm low in front of her hips — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the near-black wenge wood body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left hip, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her right shoulder and one at her right hip, where the broken edge reveals the pale raw fresh wood with a rough splintered grain, much lighter than the dark polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the near-black wenge wood is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps in black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved near-black wenge wood right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, carved from the same wenge wood with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: electric saturated hot-pink-red lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, bold pink-fuchsia eyeshadow, dramatic lashes, a deep flushed blush. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved near-black wenge wood.

Background: a sunny city plaza of light paving with a low fountain edge, a street lamp and standard-height shop doors behind her, clear daylight sky, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
